queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
),
s AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist,
         cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share,
         1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) AS mean_share
  FROM g
)
SELECT ordertypedist, share, share - mean_share AS diff
FROM s
WHERE share > mean_share;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT ordertypedist, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transactionrecord) AS share
  FROM transactionrecord
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT ordertypedist, share
FROM g
WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM g WHERE ordertypedist IN ('Market', 'Mixed', 'Limit'));
SELECT ordertypedist,
       COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share
FROM transactionrecord
WHERE ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY ordertypedist;
SELECT t.ordertypedist, COUNT(DISTINCT a.abhvreg) AS cnt
FROM advancedbehavior a
JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
GROUP BY t.ordertypedist;
SELECT COALESCE(t.ordertimepat, 'Missing') AS ordertimepat, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM advancedbehavior a
LEFT JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.ordertimepat, 'Missing');
